name: Dill
definition: fresh or frozen dill leaf (Anethum graveolens), sold in bunches or packs; dill seed and dried dill are J5.
notes: Fresh dill sold as 1 bunch; same page lists freeze-dried dill separately

name: Rosemary
definition: fresh rosemary sprigs (Salvia rosmarinus); dried rosemary is J5.
notes: Fresh Rosemary sold as 1 bunch in fresh-herbs aisle

name: Sage
definition: fresh sage leaves (Salvia officinalis); dried sage is J5.
notes: Fresh Sage 20g heat-sealed pack in Fresh Herbs category; suitable for home freezing

name: Chives
definition: fresh chives (Allium schoenoprasum) sold in bunches or packs as a herb; garlic chive is J4.2.4.07, wild chives J4.2.4.08.
notes: Schnittlauch frisch im Bund, 30 g bunch of fresh chives
